summary: Sketch geometry now shows how far dimensions and relations define it. Points, lines, arcs and circles that the analysis of the version on screen proves fully defined turn green, including lines from rectangles, slots, polylines and patterns, linked references and construction geometry, which keeps its dashes in a lighter shade. Under-defined geometry and geometry the analysis cannot classify keep the usual blue grey. Selection, hover, focus, relation and pick highlights draw over these colours exactly as before. When the solver rejects a preview, an Apply or the sketch itself, every point and edge a conflicting relation holds turns red and every one a redundant relation holds turns purple, using the complete diagnosed lists rather than the eight rows the feedback summarizes; the marks last until the preview changes or ends. The heading reads Fully defined, Under defined · N DOF or Definition unknown, where it read Fully constrained, N DOF or Freedom unknown, and a Sketch colours tip explains the legend. A point the current analysis proves defined refuses dragging, arrow-key nudges and edge or group translations that would carry it, with the hint Fully defined by dimensions and relations, and the radius grip of a defined circle is locked. Only the analysis of the exact document, sketch and version on screen locks anything: after an edit, Undo, Redo or a parameter change the colours stay until the new answer arrives and nothing is locked meanwhile, and another sketch or document shows no colours until its own answer arrives. Older profile groups, the origin and the axes keep their own colours. The colours reuse the analysis the heading already requested: hovering and dragging request no analysis, rows receive one scalar mark each, and an unchanged answer keeps its marks, so hover renders no graph rows and a new answer renders only the rows whose state changed.
warning: Potentially breaking for automation that reads human labels or drives the sketch canvas: the sketch constraint status now reads Fully defined, Under defined · N DOF or Definition unknown instead of Fully constrained, N DOF or Freedom unknown, and the locked point hint reads Fully defined by dimensions and relations. Canvas automation that drags or nudges a point, or translates an edge or group holding a point, that the current analysis proves defined is now refused in the canvas, where it previously asked the solver to move it and the solver kept it in place; the radius grip of a defined circle is locked the same way. Sketch images from cad_capture_preview show the new colours. WebMCP tools, their arguments and their results are unchanged, and agent edits keep their existing checks. No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output.

checklist.schema: No CAD schema change and no saved state: colours and locks are derived from the existing constraint inspection. No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, storage, journal, worker reply or native buffer protocol change; the Rust solver and committed WebAssembly module are unchanged. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event or input-version behavior change. A result belongs to its document, sketch and version; locks need the exact accepted document and version, so undo, redo, parameter, sketch and document changes never apply an older lock. Rejected previews and Apply attempts publish their marks through the existing preview channel and drop them when the preview changes or ends.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. The sketch canvas refuses a drag, nudge, edge or group translation that would move a point the current analysis proves defined, and locks the radius grip of a defined circle. Undefined, unknown and stale results never lock.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Saved documents open unchanged.
checklist.verification: cadSketchDefinitionMarks.test.ts checks that a rejection marks all twenty points of ten relations while its feedback lists eight subjects, expansion of relations, edges and points with missing identities skipped, conflicting over redundant over defined precedence, and reuse of equal marks. CadSketchGraphLayer.test.tsx checks that a defined point refuses drag, nudge and an edge translation while an under-defined one moves and an older definition does not lock, that a group drag holding a defined point is refused, that a defined circle locks its radius grip only while its definition is current, and that a rejected drag marks its operands in place of the published marks until Escape. CadSketchCanvasRender.test.tsx checks that hover renders no point or edge rows, an equal answer renders none and a changed answer renders exactly the changed points and edge. CadSketchConstraintStatus.test.tsx checks the reports, labels and legend. CadSketchRelationsPanel.test.tsx checks that a rejected Apply marks its operands until the draft changes. CadWorkbench.test.tsx checks a partly defined sketch with a construction guide, an unknown circle, a legacy profile and the references, selection over defined geometry, nudges refused and allowed, stale answers across a parameter change, undo and a sketch reusing the same identities, and a rejected preview beyond eight relations over the analysis marks. Each of these regression tests failed with its fix reverted. The full Vitest suite (555 files, 6300 tests), lint, ui:check, build and the release check pass. In Chromium, a new cad-sketch-constraints test turns a line green once Horizontal and a length define it, checks selection and hover over it and returns it to blue grey when the length is removed; cad-sketch-constraints and the other sketch specs pass. Hover P50 at 4x CPU in a production Chromium build, 60 rectangles, after a warm-up run: Rectangle 23.4 to 25.9 ms against 22.6 to 28.0 ms on 0.0.778, Select 21.6 to 22.6 ms against 22.1 to 22.8 ms, the same within noise and near the earlier 26 ms baseline. With all 480 points and edges fully defined and drawn green: Rectangle 24.4 to 25.5 ms against 23.3 to 24.2 ms, Select 22.1 to 23.2 ms against 22.4 to 23.2 ms, with the longest frame 33 to 67 ms against 33 to 100 ms.

publicNotes.summary: Fully defined sketch geometry turns green.
changes: Points, lines, arcs and circles that dimensions and relations fully define turn green; under-defined geometry stays blue grey.
A rejected preview or Apply marks the geometry held by conflicting relations red and by redundant relations purple, all of it and not only the rows listed.
The sketch heading reads Fully defined, Under defined · N DOF or Definition unknown, and Sketch colours explains the legend.
A fully defined point, or the radius of a fully defined circle, can no longer be dragged or nudged.
publicNotes.compatibility: No file, schema or tool change. Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged.
publicNotes.action: No action needed. Automation that reads the sketch status should expect Fully defined, Under defined · N DOF or Definition unknown.
